verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack documents Slack's channel types (public/private), invite-only membership, or admin channel-management controls; the closest items only reference MCP tools searching/sending to channels (slack-docs-46, slack-docs-28) without describing channel visibility or membership settings. Community evidence even suggests weak admin/moderation tooling for channels (slack-comm-5), but nothing concretely documents or disputes the core public/private + membership-control capability, so this axis lacks supporting evidence.
